01Baselines
Environmental Intelligence
Learn, lock and compare the real environment each channel sits in.
OPEN PILLAR →
MTDI / PILLAR 01
Pillar 01

Learn · lock · compare

Each channel learns its reference from the real environment it sits in. Lock the reference and every change after that is measured against it; it never drifts toward a new signal on its own.

Save a learned environment under a name and compare against it later. Simulated data is refused: a saved environment is evidence.

Aether

Shows that MTDI's pillars do not care what a sensor measures: the same Validation Chamber, Environmental Intelligence and NVTRA that serve Inductra serve an echo.

MTDI core

A score that can be taken apart

Eight named factors per channel, weighted, averaged over every declared channel. An offline channel scores zero. It is an evidence-quality score, not a calibrated probability.
